# Scenario coverage (generated by scripts/scenario_coverage.py)

Commit 8668c69 (dirty). **static reference map (not an execution result).** Software evidence never replaces the product scenarios: every hardware
scenario stays NOT_RUN (decision D11, docs/18 §7). This script never writes tests/scenarios.json, traceability.csv or the capability manifest.

**Limitation.** COVERED_SOFTWARE_ONLY means at least one test NAME (C++ LM_TEST prefix, pytest scenario mark) refers to the scenario id. It does not mean the test exercises every step of the scenario: a tag can be broader than the test body (FIX11-D9, review L11), and the '-style' suffix is stripped from names. Read the referenced test before relying on a row.
